rows.note: Use it after a clock time to mean exactly at that time.

example.english: The meeting starts at eight sharp tomorrow morning.
example.jyutping: ting1 jat6 ziu1 zou2 baat3 dim2 zing3 hoi1 wui2

rows.note: Use this resultative pattern when singing or playing a note above the correct pitch.

example.jyutping: nei5 go3 jam1 coeng3 gou1 zo2 wo3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a blade or tool that cuts well.

example.english: This knife is sharp, so be careful.
example.jyutping: ni1 baa2 dou1 hou2 lei6 siu2 sam1 di1

rows.note: Use this for someone who is clever, quick to notice things, or alert rather than physically sharp.

example.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 hou2 sing2 muk6 wo3

rows.note: Use this for criticism that is biting or pain that is piercing and severe, especially in more formal descriptions.

example.english: The wording of this criticism is extremely sharp.
example.traditional: 呢篇評論嘅措辭非常尖銳。
example.jyutping: ni1 pin1 ping4 leon4 ge3 cou3 ci4 fei1 soeng4 zim1 jeoi6

rows.note: Use this when sharp means exact, accurate, or well-aimed.

example.jyutping: nei5 go3 gu2 syun3 gei2 zeon2 kok3
